text.e4all_minecraft.closeServer: Local game no longer publicly hosted
text.e4all_minecraft.doctor.start: Generating troubleshooting information. Please stand by.
text.e4all_minecraft.poisonpill.badurl: e4all was downloaded from an unknown source. This copy of e4all may be outdated or modified.
text.e4all_minecraft.offlineModeEnabled: Offline mode enabled - cracked clients can now join
text.e4all_minecraft.offlineModeDisabled: Offline mode disabled - Microsoft authentication required
text.e4all_minecraft.offlineModeWarning: ⚠ WARNING: Offline Mode is enabled! Authentication is disabled, so anyone with any username can join. This cannot be undone for this session.
text.e4all_minecraft.reconnecting: e4all: Relay connection lost, attempting to reconnect...
text.e4all_minecraft.worldLoading: e4all: this world is still loading, please rejoin in a few seconds
text.e4all_minecraft.error.noActiveSessi: e4all: No active session to restart.
text.e4all_minecraft.offlineModeNote: Note: This change applies to new connections only.
text.e4all_minecraft.error.androidUnsupp: e4all: Hosting is not supported on Android. The QUIC tunnel requires native libraries built for desktop Linux/Windows/macOS.
text.e4all_minecraft.error.nativeLoadFai: e4all: Failed to load native library. This platform may not be supported. Run /e4all doctor for details.
text.e4all_minecraft.android.noNative: e4all: Android detected but no compatible QUIC library was bundled for this device. Hosting will fail. Run /e4all doctor for details.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.title: e4all Settings
text.e4all_minecraft.config.page.basic.t: Everyday settings - safe for anyone to change. Hover over an option to see what it does.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.page.advance: Server addresses used by e4all infrastructure. Only change these if you know what you are doing!
text.e4all_minecraft.config.advancedWarn: Warning: these options control e4all infrastructure endpoints. Misconfiguring them can break hosting and joining until they are restored.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.discord.tool: Join our Discord server for help and news.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.github.toolt: View the source code or report issues on GitHub.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.done.tooltip: Close this screen. All changes were saved automatically.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.hostE: Master switch for hosting: while OFF, your world cannot be shared through e4all at all.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.resto: Brings back dedicated-server commands like /ban, /pardon and /whitelist inside LAN worlds, so you can manage who plays.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.useWh: Only players on your whitelist may connect to your shared world.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.dialt: Direct player-to-player connections (faster) for people joining YOUR world. Turn OFF to force everyone through the relay instead.
Allow direct player-to-player connections when YOU join someone else's world. Turn OFF to force traffic through the relay instead.
Privacy option: removes your IP address from the connection ticket that is sent to the relay.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.hideD: Hides the e4all domain in the chat message. Clicking the message to copy still copies the full domain.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.offli: Disables Microsoft account checks so ANY client can join (including cracked clients) - use with care! Also toggleable via the 'Online Mode' button on the Open to LAN screen; both stay in sync.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.useBr: When ON, the broker automatically picks the fastest relay server for your location. When OFF, the fixed relay below is used.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.broke: Address of the broker service that picks the best relay. Only used while Auto Relay is ON.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.relay: Fixed relay server address. Only used when Auto Relay is OFF.
Port of the fixed relay server (1-65535). Only used when Auto Relay is OFF.
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.dialt: URL that lists the peer-to-peer relay servers. Leave as default unless you run your own infrastructure.
text.e4all_minecraft.info.tagline: §6e4all §7: host LAN worlds anyone can join, even offline accounts. No port forwarding needed.
text.e4all_minecraft.welcome.header: §6[e4all]§r Thanks for using e4all! Bugs, suggestions, or just want to chat/find people to play with? Join the Discord:
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.peerLack: §c[e4all voice]§r The other player doesn't have e4all installed. Voice chat requires e4all on both sides.
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.hostLack: §c[e4all voice]§r The host does not have Simple Voice Chat installed (voice chat unavailable).
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.dialtone: §c[e4all voice]§r Direct P2P connection unavailable: Voice chat disabled (voice cannot use the relay). Gameplay is unaffected! Try a VPN or ask the host to enable UPnP.
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.timeout: §c[e4all voice]§r Voice connection timed out (voice disabled). Gameplay still works fine! Try rejoining.
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.natBlock: §c[e4all voice]§r Direct connection blocked by firewall or strict Wi-Fi/NAT (voice disabled). Gameplay still works fine!
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.noShared: §c[e4all voice]§r No shared network protocol (IPv4/IPv6) between you and the host (voice disabled).
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.upnpDeni: §c[e4all voice]§r Router refused UPnP port mapping. Voice may work if the host port forwards manually.
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.firewall: §c[e4all voice]§r Firewall is blocking voice traffic (voice disabled). Gameplay still works fine!
text.e4all_minecraft.voice.fail.transpor: §c[e4all voice]§r Could not establish a direct P2P connection (voice disabled). Gameplay still works fine!
text.e4all_minecraft.domainReassigned: §6[e4all]§r Relay reconnected! The address above is NEW. Old links are no longer valid. Share this one with players.
text.e4all_minecraft.maxReconnectFailed: §c[e4all]§r Max reconnect attempts reached. Re-open the world to LAN or run /e4all restart (the address will change).
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.recon: How many times e4all will try to reconnect to the relay before giving up (default: 5).
Initial delay in seconds before the first reconnect attempt. Doubles with each subsequent attempt (default: 2).
text.e4all_minecraft.config.option.keepa: How often (in seconds) e4all pings the relay to keep the connection alive (default: 15).
text.e4all_minecraft.connectionLost: e4all: Connection lost (%s). The server, the relay, or a network path in between closed the connection unexpectedly. If you are using a VPN, its tunnel may have dropped. Try reconnecting without it.
